# Energy dashboard

The homepage energy dashboard, grown: the power flow card with rooms, price, outage and generator, today's tiles with rules, the car hero, the solar lanes, a home battery grid, and a grid section with a table and a 24 hour trend.

<DashboardGrid b64="">

```yaml
- column_span: 2
  cards:
    - { type: heading, heading: Power, icon: mdi:lightning-bolt }
    - type: custom:power-flow-card-pro
      title: Power flow
      icon: mdi:transmission-tower
      home: sensor.power_consumption
      expensive_above: 0.35
      sources:
        - { type: solar, entity: sensor.solar_power, secondary: "{{ states('sensor.solar_east') }} kW east · {{ states('sensor.solar_west') }} kW west" }
        - { type: battery, power: sensor.battery_power, soc: sensor.battery_soc, secondary: "{{ states('sensor.battery_temperature') }} °C" }
        - type: grid
          power: sensor.grid_power
          price: sensor.electricity_price
          offline: binary_sensor.grid_outage
          generator: sensor.generator_power
          fossil: sensor.grid_fossil_percentage
      consumers:
        - { entity: sensor.heat_pump_power, name: Heat pump, icon: mdi:heat-pump }
        - group: Laundry
          icon: mdi:washing-machine
          entities:
            - { entity: sensor.washer_power, name: Washer, icon: mdi:washing-machine }
            - { entity: sensor.dryer_power, name: Dryer, icon: mdi:tumble-dryer }
        - group: Kitchen
          icon: mdi:silverware-fork-knife
          entities:
            - { entity: sensor.range_hood_power, name: Range hood, icon: mdi:fan }
            - { entity: sensor.dining_light_power, name: Dining light, icon: mdi:ceiling-light }
        - { entity: sensor.office_power, name: Office, icon: mdi:monitor }
        - { entity: sensor.ev_charger_power, name: EV charger, icon: mdi:ev-station }
      rules:
        - { below: 500, color: green, label: Quiet }
        - { below: 3000, color: amber, label: Busy }
        - { above: 3000, color: red, label: Peak, tint_card: true }
    - { type: heading, heading: Today, icon: mdi:calendar-today }
    - { type: custom:entity-card-pro, entity: sensor.energy_today, name: Used today, icon: mdi:home-lightning-bolt, grid_options: { columns: 3 } }
    - type: custom:entity-card-pro
      entity: sensor.electricity_price
      name: Price
      icon: mdi:cash
      decimals: 2
      rules:
        - { below: 0.2, color: green, label: Cheap }
        - { below: 0.35, color: amber, label: Normal }
        - { above: 0.35, color: red, label: Expensive }
      grid_options: { columns: 3 }
    - type: custom:entity-card-pro
      entity: sensor.battery_soc
      name: Battery charge
      visual: ring
      rules:
        - { below: 20, color: red, label: Low }
        - { below: 50, color: amber }
        - { above: 50, color: green }
      grid_options: { columns: 3 }
    - { type: custom:entity-card-pro, entity: sensor.grid_fossil_percentage, name: Fossil share, icon: mdi:molecule-co2, grid_options: { columns: 3 } }
    - type: custom:entity-card-pro
      entity: sensor.grid_power
      name: Grid
      decimals: 0
      visual: columns
      hours_to_show: 12
      bucket_minutes: 30
      rules:
        - { below: 0, color: green, label: Exporting }
        - { above: 0, color: blue, label: Importing }
      grid_options: { columns: 6 }
    - type: custom:entity-card-pro
      entity: sensor.battery_power
      name: Battery
      decimals: 0
      visual: sparkline
      hours_to_show: 12
      bucket_minutes: 30
      rules:
        - { below: 0, color: teal, label: Charging }
        - { above: 0, color: amber, label: Discharging }
      grid_options: { columns: 6 }
- column_span: 1
  cards:
    - { type: heading, heading: Car, icon: mdi:car-electric }
    - type: custom:entity-group-card-pro
      title: Electric car
      icon: mdi:car-electric
      layout: hero
      hours_to_show: 12
      entities:
        - entity: sensor.ev_battery
          name: Battery
          visual: ring
          rules:
            - { below: 20, color: red, label: Low }
            - { below: 50, color: amber }
            - { above: 50, color: green }
        - { entity: sensor.ev_range, name: Range, icon: mdi:map-marker-distance }
        - entity: sensor.ev_charger_power
          name: Charger
          decimals: 0
          rules:
            - { below: 0, color: teal, icon: mdi:battery-arrow-up, label: Feeding home }
            - { below: 10, color: grey, icon: mdi:ev-station, label: Idle }
            - { above: 10, color: green, icon: mdi:ev-plug-type2, label: Charging }
        - entity: binary_sensor.ev_plugged
          name: Cable
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: green, icon: mdi:power-plug, label: Plugged in }
            - { state: "off", color: grey, icon: mdi:power-plug-off, label: Unplugged }
    - { type: heading, heading: Solar, icon: mdi:solar-power }
    - type: custom:multi-trend-card-pro
      title: Solar
      icon: mdi:solar-power-variant
      hours_to_show: 12
      layout: lanes
      entities:
        - { entity: sensor.solar_east, name: East roof, color: amber }
        - { entity: sensor.solar_west, name: West roof, color: orange }
    - type: custom:entity-group-card-pro
      title: Home battery
      icon: mdi:home-battery
      layout: grid
      columns: 2
      entities:
        - entity: sensor.battery_soc
          name: Charge
          visual: ring
          rules:
            - { below: 20, color: red, label: Low }
            - { below: 50, color: amber }
            - { above: 50, color: green }
        - entity: sensor.battery_power
          name: Power
          decimals: 0
          rules:
            - { below: 0, color: green, icon: mdi:battery-charging, label: Charging }
            - { above: 0, color: amber, icon: mdi:battery-arrow-down, label: Discharging }
        - { entity: sensor.battery_temperature, name: Temperature, decimals: 1 }
        - { entity: sensor.ev_charger_power, name: EV charger, icon: mdi:ev-station, decimals: 0 }
- column_span: 3
  cards:
    - { type: heading, heading: Grid, icon: mdi:transmission-tower }
    - type: custom:entity-sections-card-pro
      title: Grid connection
      icon: mdi:transmission-tower
      show_icon: true
      sections:
        - layout: table
          entities:
            - entity: binary_sensor.grid_outage
              name: Status
              visual: badge
              rules:
                - { state: "on", color: red, icon: mdi:transmission-tower-off, label: Outage, tint_card: true }
                - { state: "off", color: green, icon: mdi:transmission-tower, label: Connected }
            - entity: sensor.grid_power
              name: Power
              decimals: 0
              rules:
                - { below: 0, color: green, label: Exporting }
                - { above: 0, color: blue, label: Importing }
            - { entity: sensor.electricity_price, name: Price, decimals: 2 }
            - { entity: sensor.grid_fossil_percentage, name: Fossil share, icon: mdi:molecule-co2 }
            - { entity: sensor.generator_power, name: Generator, icon: mdi:engine, decimals: 0 }
      grid_options: { columns: 4 }
    - type: custom:multi-trend-card-pro
      title: Grid & consumption
      icon: mdi:chart-line
      hours_to_show: 24
      x_axis: true
      y_axis: true
      entities:
        - { entity: sensor.grid_power, name: Grid, color: purple }
        - { entity: sensor.power_consumption, name: Consumption, color: blue }
      grid_options: { columns: 8, rows: 1 }
```

</DashboardGrid>
